S_AcademyCartography.name: Rex Fleet Academy Systems Theater
S_AcademyCartography.text: Bastion Spire Academy teaching room built for systems, history, and navigation seminars: stepped seating, a broad central floor, physical desks, and one large wall-scale route display capable of showing corridor networks without turning the room into a generic hologram chamber. Blue, gold, and white Academy/Fleet design is restrained and functional. Windows look toward the Bastion Rings and distant dock traffic.

S_CrownGalleryTransit.name: Crown Gallery Transit Walk
S_CrownGalleryTransit.text: Public passage through Bastion Spire beside the Crown Gallery: immense ship banners and memorial architecture coexist with commuters, cadets, dock workers, baggage carts, and sightlines into working drydocks. The ceremonial scale is impressive, but the place is visibly used every day.

S_AnchorMarketsCore.name: Bastion Spire Anchor Markets
S_AnchorMarketsCore.text: Crowded market concourse inside Bastion Spire where Core silks, Verge grain and glasswork, Shard-forged salvage, ship provisions, food stalls, repair counters, and travelers mix under the same vaulted structure. Color comes from goods, people, lanterns, and faction accents; avoid generic beige market scenery.

S_NerisStall.name: Ma Neris Shatterbread Stall
S_NerisStall.text: Long-running Meridian-family bread stall operating in the Bastion Anchor Markets: hot stone ovens, flour bins, dense dark Shatterbread loaves, ordinary breakfast breads, family lantern token, handwritten order slips kept mostly unreadable unless specifically scripted, and a narrow service counter facing constant foot traffic.

S_MeridianFerry.name: Bastion–Meridian Passenger Ferry
S_MeridianFerry.text: Clean civilian transfer ferry with broad observation windows and simple rows of seats, carrying workers, cadets, families, and market travelers between Bastion orbitals and Meridian. Through the glass, Meridian appears blue-green and enormous, with luminous cities and storm belts rather than a decorative fantasy planet.

S_CoreSpireLogistics.name: Core Spire Station Logistics Ring
S_CoreSpireLogistics.text: Working civilian traffic-allocation floor inside Core Spire Station: layered route displays, dispatch desks, corridor-status bands, headset teams, cargo windows, maintenance routing, and quiet urgency. Public route maps emphasize major green corridors while operations views reveal smaller maintenance spurs and contingency links. Red means unsafe or held; green means verified low-tension/safe.
